notes: ESP32-C3: up to 4 GIFs at the same time while there is memory (was 2); with 3-4 outputs about 3 KB more free memory
Zones are put back after a restart also when a preset is applied at start-up; the app shows whether the saved zones were put back
ESP32-C3: 3 or 4 LED outputs all sent together over SPI (no more frozen LEDs with Bluetooth); zones kept after a restart. (v96 was too big for the ESP32-C3 and could not be installed.)
